summary: Hono transport adapters. Product contracts and authorization remain in shared contracts and the corresponding service ports.

key_files.asset-capability.ts: Consumes existing signed Resource capabilities. Project replica multipart requests recheck admission and exact references; generic preview/range streaming retains its existing policy.
key_files.plugin-output-sessions.ts: /assets/plugin-output/:grant (begin) and /:grant/:sessionId (shared multipart PUT) for remote plugin media outputs. The signed run-scoped grant is the only authority; session and multipart protocol are the shared Project Asset import ones.
key_files.project-content-transfer.ts: Shared HTTP glue for Resource and Document all-PUT multipart phases and exact-length streaming responses. Begin reports the part numbers and content hashes a live session already holds so an interrupted sender resumes. No client storage locator, ETag or resource list is accepted as authority.
key_files.project-content-transfer.test.ts: Checks incremental response delivery, actual overflow/truncation failure and explicit unsupported storage without buffered fallback.
key_files.v1/project-content.ts: Project Resource capability issuance and immutable Document body transport; authoritative Loro references and current exact replica admission gate every request.
key_files.gateway.ts: /gateway/* surface authenticated by sk_gw_ tokens only (outside the /api/* session middleware; x-user-id never read). GET /gateway/me returns the token-derived identity. /gateway/v1/* is gateway-core createGatewayApp over the D1 ports in ../gateway (#347). Guides: apps/docs/guide/gateway-tokens.md, gateway-data-plane.md.
key_files.v1/gateway-tokens.ts: POST /api/v1/gateway/tokens (mint from session or clsh_), POST /tokens/:id/renew (same parent only), DELETE /tokens/:id (owner revoke). Coded GatewayErrors; the token appears only in the no-store mint response.
